description: Resolve ENS names to addresses, e.g. 'What address is vitalik.eth?'. Takes up to 50 names and returns each name's address for one coin: ETH by default, or another chain or currency such as btc, base or sol. A name without an address for the coin returns null. For a name's full profile (text records, avatar, website) use get_profile.

coin.description: Coin symbol such as eth, btc, sol, base or op, or a numeric coin type (ENSIP-9/11)

names.description: 1 to 50 ENS names as the user wrote them

items.description: ENS name as the user wrote it, e.g. nick.eth; normalised by the server (ENSIP-15)
